scope: Deepen within same draft PR; do not modify original 18-Read prereg, frozen V2, production prompts or paid-model APIs
read_sequence_secondary_protocol: Extract pedagogical order from official Read headings, exemplar, motion descriptions and question markers; DO NOT convert section position to video timestamp, real-frame state or narrator quotes.
scene_source_protocol: Match first-party 3b1b/videos paths from official Read links or the repository with explicit inference qualification; read scene class names and specific self.play/wait/Transform mechanism; source order not proven final video edit order.
negative_cases: static diagram is adequate when time evolution irrelevant
long pauses/question prompts may be useful
not every dense explanation needs motion
not every transformation should preserve visual identity without mathematical meaning
publication_gate: If 15 verified video-audio/frame records impossible, report VIDEO_AUDIT_NO_GO with precise blocker and submit source/Read-only bounded research without inflated claims.
